title: MEMORY IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: MECHANISMS, EVALUATION AND EVOLUTION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating mid-span evidence utilization using position-performance curves, length-performance slopes, and Needle-in-a-Haystack tests to measure the degradation of context utilization across different token positions in long sequences.

Measuring scoring drift, order bias, and self-preference bias in automated adjudicators by employing dual adjudication, tracking inter-rater agreement statistics (e.g., Cohen's kappa, Krippendorff's alpha), and calculating confidence intervals.
